title: Minyah Dragonsister
dek: Public honor changes Minyah’s status, but she still calls herself a lowly spy and looks toward the next mission.
sources: Zarathis_Dragonsisters_NPC_Master.md — supplied 5 October 2026; quest-RP parts 024, 026, 030 and explicit evidence distinctions
body:
Minyah is one of the Dragonsisters, whose long-term intelligence service helped Zarathis win its war. She waves during the public introduction and shares the elevation to lady of the lands with Sheeva and Kaiya.

Honor has not changed her self-description

At the later August gathering, Minyah tells Scribonia that the sisters are unused to such invitations. Their wartime work earned them recognition, but she still describes them as simply lowly spies.

This is her self-perception, not proof that the state never elevated them. The difference preserves the experience of an operative whose work mattered long before the public knew her name.

A warrior with a mind

While Kaiya turns toward scholarship and Sheeva takes a reprieve, Minyah prepares to go back out. She joins martial identity to the work of thinking:

I am a warrior with a mind. I must use it.Minyah Dragonsister

The war’s end does not end her sense of usefulness. The next mission’s destination, objectives, and outcome are not supplied by this record.

Service and the sisters

Her conversation while dancing with Scribonia is evidence of modesty, unfamiliarity with high society, and continued commitment to work. It does not establish a romantic arc comparable to Sheeva’s relationship with Eugene.

The sisters remain close while choosing different postwar lives. Minyah’s views on Eugene, her deeper relationship with Eldin, age, ancestry, full wartime experience, and later fate remain unknown.
